# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A pixel-art styled Pomodoro timer built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Works fully offline — no packages, network requests, or external assets.

## Features

- 25-minute work mode and 5-minute break mode
- Large countdown display
- Start/Pause and Reset buttons
- Keyboard-accessible controls with visible focus states
- Pixel-art inspired UI with a cohesive dark palette
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Use the mode buttons to switch between work and break, then press START to begin. Press PAUSE to stop the timer, and RESET to restore the full duration for the current mode.

## Files

- `index.html` — page structure and controls
- `style.css` — pixel-art styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` — timer logic and event handling

## Accessibility

All controls are real `<button>` elements with labels and ARIA attributes. The countdown uses `aria-live="polite"` and `role="timer"` so screen readers can announce updates. Focus indicators are clearly visible.

## Notes

The timer uses `Date.now()` to avoid drift from `setInterval` inaccuracy. When the countdown reaches zero, it stops; switch modes or reset to start again.
